rows.ja: AI・クラウド・データの提携先
業務・コンサル系の提携先
連携・再販先(各社の年次報告に記載)
rows.en: Integration & resale partners (named in their annual reports)

relations.text: RISE with SAP on Azureは、MicrosoftとSAPが共同で提供する取り組みである
relations.text_en: RISE with SAP on Azure is delivered jointly by Microsoft and SAP

source.label: May 11, 2026 · RISE with SAP on Azure
source.label_en: May 11, 2026 · RISE with SAP on Azure
source.quote: The RISE with SAP on Microsoft Azure initiative is more than just a technical offering; it’s a strategic investment in customer success, delivered jointly by Microsoft and SAP.

relations.text: SAPとGoogle Cloudが、データ・分析の提携を拡大し、SAP Business Data Cloud Connect for Google BigQueryを発表した
relations.text_en: SAP and Google Cloud expanded their data and analytics partnership with the launch of SAP Business Data Cloud Connect for Google BigQuery

source.label: SAP 20-F
source.quote: - On October 6, SAP and Google Cloud announced that they would expand their long-standing data and analytics partnership with the launch of SAP Business Data Cloud Connect for Google BigQuery—a new capability that aims to simplify access to mission-critical SAP data products from SAP Business Data Cloud through bidirectional, zero-copy data sharing.

relations.text: SAPとAlibaba Groupが、戦略的提携の拡大を発表した
relations.text_en: SAP and Alibaba Group announced an extension of their strategic partnership

source.label: SAP 20-F
source.quote: - On May 27, SAP and Alibaba Group announced an extension of their strategic partnership to accelerate cloud transformation.

relations.text: SAPのクラウド4製品を、中国でAlibaba Cloud上に段階的に提供する計画を発表した
relations.text_en: SAP and Alibaba announced a phased launch of four SAP cloud solutions on Alibaba Cloud in China

source.label: SAP 20-F
source.quote: - Also on September 24, SAP and Alibaba announced plans to advance their strategic partnership with the phased launch of four SAP cloud solutions (SAP Cloud ERP, SAP Cloud ERP Private, SAP BTP, and SAP Integrated Business Planning) on Alibaba Cloud for Chinese enterprises in China.

relations.text: SAPとPalantirが、SAP Business Data CloudとPalantirのAI基盤を連携させる提携を発表した
relations.text_en: SAP and Palantir announced a partnership connecting SAP Business Data Cloud with Palantir's Ontology and AI Platform

source.label: SAP 20-F
source.quote: In addition, SAP and Palantir announced a partnership to facilitate joint customers’ cloud migration journeys and modernization programs by connecting the unified, context-rich data environment of SAP Business Data Cloud with Palantir’s Ontology and Artificial Intelligence Platform.

relations.text: SAPとSnowflakeが、SAP Business Data Cloud向けのSAP Snowflake solution extensionを発表した
relations.text_en: SAP and Snowflake announced the SAP Snowflake solution extension for SAP Business Data Cloud

source.label: SAP 20-F
source.quote: - On November 4, SAP and Snowflake, an AI data cloud company, announced the SAP Snowflake solution extension for SAP Business Data Cloud to bring Snowflake’s data and AI capabilities directly to SAP customers.

relations.text: SAPとOpenAIが、ドイツの公共部門向けのOpenAI for Germanyを発表した
relations.text_en: SAP and OpenAI announced OpenAI for Germany, a partnership for Germany's public sector

source.label: SAP 20-F
source.quote: - On September 24, SAP and OpenAI announced the launch of OpenAI for Germany, a partnership to bring SAP’s enterprise applications expertise and OpenAI’s leading AI technology to Germany’s public sector.

relations.text: SAPとAnthropicが、ClaudeをSAPのAI製品群に組み込む協業の拡大計画を発表した
relations.text_en: SAP and Anthropic announced plans to expand their collaboration, making Claude a primary reasoning and agentic capability across SAP's AI portfolio

source.label: SAP — planned Anthropic Business AI collaboration, May 12, 2026
source.label_en: SAP — planned Anthropic Business AI collaboration, May 12, 2026
source.quote: SAP and Anthropic today announced plans to expand their collaboration to deliver advanced AI solutions to enterprise customers, making Claude, Anthropic’s AI model, a primary reasoning and agentic capability embedded across SAP’s AI-enabled solution portfolio, powered by Joule and Joule agents.

relations.text: SAPとAccentureが、新しいADVANCEの提供で提携を拡大すると発表した
relations.text_en: SAP and Accenture announced an expanded partnership through the new ADVANCE offering

source.label: SAP 20-F
source.quote: - On May 20, SAP and Accenture announced an expansion of their partnership to help companies enable connected intelligence across the enterprise to drive speed and agility in the AI era through the new ADVANCE offering.

relations.text: SAPが、Capgeminiなどとの新規・拡大した協業を発表した
relations.text_en: SAP announced new and expanded collaborations with Capgemini and others

source.label: SAP 20-F
source.quote: - On November 18, SAP announced new and expanded collaborations with Mistral AI, Bleu, and Capgemini at the Franco-German EU Summit on Digital Sovereignty.

relations.text: SAPとADPが、ADP Global Payrollをクラウドで利用できるようにする提携を発表した
relations.text_en: SAP and ADP announced a partnership to let shared clients run ADP Global Payroll in the cloud

source.label: SAP 20-F
source.quote: - On September 19, SAP and ADP, a global leader in HR and payroll solutions, announced that they would partner to enable shared clients to run ADP Global Payroll in the cloud.

relations.text: OpenTextの年次報告が、SAPと提携し、同社の製品がSAPの基盤に組み込まれていると述べている
relations.text_en: OpenText's annual report says it partners with SAP and its content products are embedded in the SAP infrastructure

source.label: OpenText 10-K
source.quote: We partner with SAP on content services and our content products are embedded in the SAP infrastructure.

relations.text: BlackLineの年次報告が、SAPなどの再販業者が自社製品を販売し得ると述べている
relations.text_en: BlackLine's annual report says resellers such as SAP may sell its products

source.label: BlackLine 10-K
source.quote: Also, resellers, such as SAP, may impose unfavorable terms on us that they pass down from their own agreements with the end customer.

relations.text: BlackLineの年次報告が、SAPなどの技術ベンダーとの関係を販売に活用していると述べている
relations.text_en: BlackLine's annual report says its sales force leverages relationships with technology vendors such as SAP

source.label: BlackLine 10-K
source.quote: Our direct sales force leverages relationships with technology vendors, such as Workday, SAP, and Microsoft, professional services firms, such as Accenture, Deloitte, and Ernst & Young, and business process outsourcers, such as CapGemini, GenPact, and RSM to influence and drive customer growth.

relations.text: Sprinklrの年次報告が、SAPを含む企業向けプラットフォームとの連携を挙げている
relations.text_en: Sprinklr's annual report lists integrations with enterprise platforms including SAP

source.label: Sprinklr 10-K
source.quote: We work with agencies and partners across nine different partner categories, including System Integrators, Transformational partners and Resellers, which includes partners such as Microsoft, Accenture, Deloitte, Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow, Adobe, Oracle and others.

relations.text: Docusignの年次報告が、SAPを戦略的な技術パートナーとし、製品連携と共同販売があると述べている
relations.text_en: Docusign's annual report names SAP as a strategic technology partner with product integrations and co-selling

source.label: Docusign 10-K
source.quote: Within our GTM strategy evolution, we are investing in deeper partner engagement across strategic technology partners like Microsoft, SAP, and Salesforce with whom we have both product integrations and co-selling relationships.

relations.text: Oktaの年次報告が、連携先の例にSAPを挙げている
relations.text_en: Okta's annual report lists SAP among its integrations

source.label: Okta 10-K
source.quote: The Okta Integration Network contains over 7,000 integrations with cloud, mobile and web applications, IoT devices and IT infrastructure providers, including AWS, Atlassian, DocuSign, Google, Microsoft 365, NetSuite, Oracle, Palo Alto Networks, Proofpoint, Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow, Slack, Splunk, VMware, Workday, Zendesk and Zoom.

relations.text: Dynatraceの年次報告が、SAPのマーケットプレイスでも自社ソフトを購入できると述べている
relations.text_en: Dynatrace's annual report says customers can procure its software through the SAP marketplace

source.label: Dynatrace 10-K
source.quote: Our customers are also able to procure our software through leading marketplaces, such as AWS, Azure, SAP, and Google.

relations.text: RISE with SAP on Azureの導入企業として、Samsungが挙げられている
relations.text_en: Samsung is named among enterprises transforming with RISE with SAP on Azure

source.label: May 11, 2026 · RISE with SAP on Azure
source.label_en: May 11, 2026 · RISE with SAP on Azure
source.quote: Thousands of enterprise customers are already transforming their businesses with RISE with SAP on Azure, including Nestle , Migros, and Samsung
source.note: Samsungの事業体は特定されていません。
source.note_en: The Samsung entity is not specified.

companies.sub: 企業向けソフト・クラウド

relations.text: Oracleの年次報告が、SAPを競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Names SAP as a competitor in its annual report

source.label: Oracle annual filing · named competition
source.quote: the largest and most competitive companies in the world, including Adobe Systems Incorporated, Alphabet Inc., Amazon.com, Inc., Cisco Systems, Inc., Intel Corporation, International Business Machines Corporation, Microsoft Corporation, Salesforce, Inc. and SAP SE, as well as other companies like Hewlett-Packard Enterprise and Workday, Inc.

relations.text: Workdayの年次報告が、SAPを競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Names SAP as a competitor in its annual report

source.label: Workday 10-K
source.quote: Our primary competitors are Oracle and SAP, well-established providers of financial management and HCM applications, which have long-standing relationships with customers and partners.

relations.text: Pegasystemsの年次報告が、SAPを競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Names SAP as a competitor in its annual report

source.label: Pegasystems 10-K
source.quote: Many of our competitors, such as International Business Machines Corporation (“IBM”), Microsoft Corporation, Oracle Corporation, Salesforce, SAP SE, and ServiceNow, have far greater resources than we do and may be able to respond more quickly and efficiently to new or emerging technologies, programming languages or

relations.text: Paycom Softwareの年次報告が、SAPを競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Names SAP as a competitor in its annual report

source.label: Paycom Software 10-K
source.quote: We compete with companies such as Automatic Data Processing, Inc., Dayforce, Inc., Intuit, Inc., Oracle Corporation, Paychex, Inc., Paylocity Holding Corporation, SAP SE, ServiceNow, Inc., Ultimate Kronos Group, Workday, Inc., and other international, national, regional, and local providers.

relations.text: PTCの年次報告が、SAPを競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Names SAP as a competitor in its annual report

source.label: PTC 10-K
source.quote: For our SLM products, we compete with enterprise software companies such as Oracle, SAP, IFS AB, Microsoft, and Salesforce, and with companies that offer point solutions.

relations.text: Freshworksの年次報告が、SAPを競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Names SAP as a competitor in its annual report

source.label: Freshworks 10-K
source.quote: For our customer experience products, we primarily face competition from customer service suites such as Salesforce, Zendesk, Intercom, and legacy vendors, such as Oracle and SAP, and from customer relationship management vendors, such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics, and Sage.
